source_reconciliation.conclusion: TX_TEMPORAL_NONE is a constant/default diagnostic value, not a valid one-trial transaction execution policy. The original PE06 A/B route was invalid and must not be used for timing evidence.

corrected_pretiming_harness.purpose: Keep transaction topology, accepted physical branch, mass accounting and principal Richards solve count exactly equal between A and B while preventing the external temporal identity comparison from splitting the benchmark arms.
corrected_pretiming_harness.arm_B: FMR_NUMERICAL_CONTINUATION_RICHARDS_TEMPORAL_HISTORY; seeded accepted right-derivative history; temporal service executes after each of the three principal advances
corrected_pretiming_harness.normalization: A positive test-oracle budget may be obtained from an untimed seeded-history preflight using the same corrected external-full-half harness; this is measurement scaffolding only and is not an application H_budget policy.
corrected_pretiming_harness.timing_interpretation: End-to-end paired delta is for three temporal-service invocations. Per-service characterization may divide only fixed-count aggregate work, while wall-clock results must retain both aggregate and per-service provenance.

hard_gates: A and B each complete exactly one transaction attempt with zero retries and zero rollbacks
A and B each execute exactly three principal Richards advances
A and B principal nonlinear iterations, Jacobian builds, internal retries, backtracking and alternative solver calls are identical
B aggregate linear solve count equals A plus exactly three defect reference_tridag calls
A and B candidate physical state is bitwise identical
A and B strict mass result and maximum step mass residual are bitwise identical
Only B carries accepted derivative continuation state
nonclaims: The huge temporal tolerance is not a production accuracy policy and qualifies no physical fidelity concession.
The external-full-half harness is benchmark scaffolding, not the production model-certificate execution route.
PE06 still does not select H_budget, BALANCED or THROUGHPUT policy.
No wall-clock evidence is admissible until this corrected pre-timing equivalence gate passes O0 and O2.
